viewing_check: Turn each head or lift wigs to read incised marks on back of head and neck (maker, mould number, 'Germany', 'Grace S. Putnam' for the Bye-Lo); check for hairlines, cracks or repairs by torch, whether eyes are glass sleep eyes working, body stamps, and if bodies are original or mixed. Photograph all marks.
